scripts.text:
[Airship Crew]
If we've landed at
your destination and
you'd like to leave the
Airship, please use the
stairs up ahead. Thank
you for your patronage.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇船员]
如果您已到达目的地并想下船，
请走前方的楼梯。
感谢您的惠顾。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Wow, mom!
L-look at this!
We're flying! W-we're...
We're in the freakin' sky!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
哇，妈妈！
看...快看！
我们在飞！我...我们...
我们在天上飞耶！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Makumalagu!
Saampa joojimbo
kaku na jedi Solo.
Bwahahahahahahaah!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
Makumalagu!
Saampa joojimbo
kaku na jedi Solo.
Bwahahahahahahaah!

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Shush...
Honey, behave~
Don't act so excited
when we're out in a
public place like this!
scripts.translation:
[女士]
嘘...
亲爱的，乖一点~
在这种公共场合，
别这么兴奋嘛！

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Chooktu!
Sacraup matii!
Shaka gurftalfi
huntiki manjoo!
scripts.translation:
[女士]
Chooktu!
Sacraup matii!
Shaka gurftalfi
huntiki manjoo!

scripts.text:
[Chrmlim]
Hey there~
From that look on
your face, I see that
you can understand
me. ^333333*Whew...!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[查姆林]
你好~
看你的表情，
我就知道你能听懂我说话。
^333333*呼...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Chrmlim]
I've been helping the
Airship enterprise by
having the Airship Crewmen
train in Umbala to overcome
any acrophobia they might have through bungee jumping. Neat, eh?
scripts.translation:
[查姆林]
我一直在协助飞空艇公司，
让飞空艇船员在汶巴拉进行训练，
通过蹦极来克服他们可能有的恐高症。
很酷吧？

scripts.text:
[Chrmlim]
But...
Some of them couldn't
overcome their fear of
heights. And a few even
ended up, um, ^333333in Niflheim^000000.
scripts.translation:
[查姆林]
但是...
有些人还是无法克服对高度的恐惧。
甚至有几个人最后...嗯，^333333掉到了尼弗海姆^000000。

scripts.text:
[Chrmlim]
Bajoo ga
nukta Airship.
scripts.translation:
[查姆林]
Bajoo ga
nukta Airship.

scripts.text:
[Chrmlim]
Shabala moow bajama
Airship kulaha googoona 
salu. Dama, kookoo na nu
yukuta. Um, fashuku na ret!
scripts.translation:
[查姆林]
Shabala moow bajama
Airship kulaha googoona 
salu. Dama, kookoo na nu
yukuta. Um, fashuku na ret!

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
Welcome
to the Airship.
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
欢迎光临飞空艇。
请问有什么可以帮您？

scripts.text: Do you have a passenger named Thierry?
scripts.translation: 有位叫蒂埃里的乘客吗？

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
I am sorry, but I do not think that we have a passenger by that name.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
很抱歉，我想我们没有叫这个名字的乘客。

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
Welcome
to the Airship.
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
欢迎光临飞空艇。
请问有什么可以帮您？

scripts.text: Using the Airship
scripts.translation: 使用飞空艇

scripts.text: Captain's Cabin
scripts.translation: 船长室

scripts.text: Facilities
scripts.translation: 设施

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
When you see a broadcast
announcing that we have
arrived at your destination,
please use one of the exits
located at the north and
south ends of the Airship.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
当您听到广播通知已到达目的地时，
请使用飞空艇南北两端的出口之一。

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
If you happen to miss
your stop, don't worry.
The Airship is constantly
en route and you'll get
another chance to arrive
to your intended destination.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
如果您不小心错过了站点，别担心。
飞空艇一直在运行中，
您还有机会到达您想去的目的地。

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
The Captain's Cabin
is located at the front
of the Airship. There, you
can meet the captain and
the pilot of the Airship.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
船长室位于飞空艇的前部。
在那里，您可以见到飞空艇的船长和飞行员。

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
The Airship provides
various Mini Games for
the entertainment of all
our passengers. We invite
you to try your luck and skills
in the Airship's Mini Games~
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
飞空艇为各位乘客提供了各种小游戏。
欢迎您来尝试运气和技巧，
在飞空艇的小游戏中一展身手~

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
Well, I hope you
your flight aboard
our Airships. Thank
you and have a good day.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
好了，希望您能享受
乘坐我们飞空艇的旅程。
谢谢，祝您有美好的一天。

scripts.text:
[Zerta]
Oh, hello adventurer.
I am currently on a
sacred journey, offering
prayer for the sake of the
Midgard continent.
scripts.translation:
[泽塔]
哦，你好，冒险者。
我正在进行神圣的旅程，
为米德加尔特大陆祈祷。

scripts.text:
[Maelin]
Um, this Airship is
to Lutie, isn't it? I've
waiting so long,
but I haven't heard any
broadcast about Lutie.
scripts.translation:
[梅琳]
嗯，这艘飞空艇是开往姜饼城的吧？
我等了很久了，
但一直没听到关于姜饼城的广播。

scripts.text:
[Aanos]
Oh wooow~
The sky looks
so different and
pretty from up there!
scripts.translation:
[阿诺斯]
哇哦~
从上面看，天空
看起来好不一样，
好漂亮啊！

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
I wish that I could go drink a cold fresh beer.
Drinking is the goal of my life! Drinking gives me energy!
I am nothing without drinks!
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
我真希望能去喝杯冰镇的新鲜啤酒。
喝酒是我的人生目标！喝酒能给我能量！
没有酒我就什么都不是！

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
But! Driving under the influence is not good.
But! That makes me want to drink more and more!
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
但是！酒后驾驶是不好的。
但是！这让我更想喝，越喝越多！

scripts.text: Do you know a passenger named Thierry?
scripts.translation: 你认识一位名叫蒂埃里的乘客吗？

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
This uniform is
really dapper, but
it's way too thick to
wear around the Airship.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
这身制服
真的很帅气，
但在飞空艇上穿
实在太厚了。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
...
......
No one ever really
comes into this room.
And the captain IS a reindeer. I could just strip to my boxers.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
...
......
从来没有人
真正进过这个房间。
而且船长是一只驯鹿。我可以直接只穿内裤。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Wah!? Who is it!
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
哇！？是谁！

scripts.text: - ...He is not listening to you, at all. -
scripts.translation: - ...他完全没在听你说话。-

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
It's been sooo
long since I've
enjoyed a nice, cold
alcoholic brew. But the
job requires me to be as
clear headed as I can!
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
我已经很久很久
没有享受过
一杯冰凉的酒精饮料了。但工作
要求我保持头脑清醒！

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Always drink responsibly!
Still, I can't remember the
last time I had a real vacation
or even a day off. Yeap, some
booze, some chips, some TV
and serious R&R is in order.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
请适量饮酒！
不过，我想不起
上次真正的假期
甚至休息日是什么时候了。是的，
来点酒，吃点薯片，看看电视，
好好放松一下。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Man, the weather
is really nice today.
Bright, open skies make
for some good visibility
and safe, carefree flying.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
天哪，今天天气
真好。
晴朗开阔的天空
能见度很高，
飞行安全又自在。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
You know, our captain's a
respectable guy. Him and
his brother are actually well
known in the aircraft industry.
Who knew reindeer made
such good captains?
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
你知道吗，我们的船长
是个很体面的人。他和
他的兄弟在航空业
其实很有名。
谁能想到驯鹿
能当这么好的船长呢？

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Just between you
and me, I gotta tell
you, that Santa was onto
something, getting reindeers
and elves to work for him.
The man must be a genius!
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
悄悄告诉你，
我得说，
圣诞老人
确实有先见之明，
让驯鹿和精灵为他工作。
这人一定是个天才！

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
You know, this whole
piloting thing in the air,
it's rather new, you know?
Yeah, they got this Airship
operation in a hurry.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
你知道吗，
在空中驾驶这件事，
其实很新，你知道吗？
是的，他们匆忙
启动了这项飞空艇业务。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Still, they were real
serious, really thought
ahead. I mean, they had us
training while the Airships
were still being invented.
Isn't that freakin' crazy?!
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
不过，他们确实
很认真，
很有远见。我是说，
在飞空艇还在发明的时候，
他们就在训练我们了。
这不是很疯狂吗？！

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Welcome to Fruitz's
Shop where you can
purchase Apples or grind
them to make Apple Juice.
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
欢迎来到弗鲁茨的商店，
这里可以购买苹果，
或者将其研磨制成苹果汁。

scripts.text: Buy Apples.
scripts.translation: 购买苹果

scripts.text: Make Apple Juice.
scripts.translation: 制作苹果汁

scripts.text: Why are you here?
scripts.translation: 你为什么在这里？

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Please enter the amount
of Apples that you wish to
buy. Each Apple is 15 zeny
and you can buy a maximum
of 500 at a time. Please enter
 '0' to cancel your order.
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
请输入您希望购买的苹果数量。
每个苹果15 Zeny，
一次最多可购买500个。
请输入“0”取消订单。

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Thanks for stopping
by my shop. Farewell!
Come by anytime when
you feel like having an
Apple to snack on~
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
感谢光临我的小店。再见！
想吃苹果点心时，
随时欢迎再来哦~

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
You've entered a number
higher than the maximum
value of 500. Please enter
the number of Apples you
wish to purchase again.
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
您输入的数字超过了最大值500。
请重新输入您希望购买的苹果数量。

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
A total of ^FF0000{0}^000000 Apples
will cost you ^FF0000{1}^000000 zeny.
Would you like to continue?
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
总共^FF0000{0}^000000个苹果
需要^FF0000{1}^000000 Zeny。
您确定要继续吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Thanks for stopping
by my shop. Farewell!
Come by anytime when
you feel like having an
Apple to snack on~
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
感谢光临我的小店。再见！
想吃苹果点心时，
随时欢迎再来哦~

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have enough money to
purchase that many Apples.
Please check your zeny or
purchase fewer Apples.
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足，
无法购买这么多苹果。
请检查您的Zeny，
或减少购买数量。

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Hmmm, I don't think
you've got enough room in
your inventory to carry this
many Apples. Why don't you free up some of your inventory space?
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
嗯，我觉得您的背包空间
不足以装下这么多苹果。
为什么不腾出一些背包空间呢？

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Thanks for stopping by
my shop. I hope you enjoy
the flavor of these Apples~!
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
感谢光临我的小店。
希望您喜欢这些苹果的味道~！

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Okay, I'll need
^FF00003 Apples and 1 Empty Bottle^000000
to make 1 Apple Juice for you.
Would you like to proceed?
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
好的，我需要
^FF00003个苹果和1个空瓶^000000
来为您制作1瓶苹果汁。
您确定要继续吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have enough materials to
create a bottle of Apple Juice.
Remember, I need 3 Apples
and 1 Empty Bottle to do it.
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
很抱歉，您的材料不足，
无法制作一瓶苹果汁。
请记住，我需要3个苹果
和1个空瓶才能制作。

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Thank you,
please wait
just a moment.
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
谢谢，
请稍等
片刻。

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Grind grind*
*Grind grind*
*Clang...!*^000000

[Fruitz]
There you go~
I hope you enjoy!
Please feel free to
stop by for your Apple
and Apple Juice needs
at anytime, adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
给您~
希望您喜欢！
冒险者，
随时欢迎来购买
苹果和苹果汁~

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Thanks for stopping
by my shop. Farewell!
Come by anytime when
you feel like having an
Apple to snack on~
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
感谢光临我的小店。再见！
想吃苹果点心时，
随时欢迎再来哦~

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
I used to be a wandering
vagabond when, one day,
I took a nap and something
struck my head and awoke
me from my restful slumber.
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
我以前是个流浪汉，
有一天，
我打了个盹，
结果被什么东西
砸中了头，
把我从美梦中惊醒。

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
It turns out that I was
sleeping beneath an apple
tree and that an apple fell
and hit me on the head.
I was dying of hunger and
was about to eat that Apple...
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
原来我睡在一棵苹果树下，
结果一个苹果掉下来砸中了我的头。
我当时饿得快要死了，
正准备吃掉那个苹果...

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
But suddenly, Kain, my old
friend from the mining days,
asked me to help him around
on the Airship. So I did, and
it was there where I found some
people playing the Dice game.
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
但突然，我在矿山时期认识的老朋友凯恩，
邀请我去飞空艇上帮忙。于是我去了，
在那里我发现了一些人在玩骰子游戏。

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
I was bored and curious
and ended up wagering that
single Apple in a game of
dice. But for some reason,
I had this incredible lucky
streak. One apple became two...
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
我既无聊又好奇，
于是拿那唯一的苹果赌了一把。
但不知为何，
我运气好得惊人。一个苹果变成了两个...

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Two became four and
before I knew it, I had
cornered the Apple market!
I won so many Apples, I just
started my own business here
on the Airship. Weird, huh?
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
两个变成了四个，
不知不觉间，
我已经垄断了苹果市场！
我赢了很多苹果，
于是就在这飞空艇上开了自己的店。奇怪吧？

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
So Apples are good
for you. They were
certainly very good
to me. Hahahahaah~!
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
所以说苹果对身体好。
它们确实对我很好呢。哈哈哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Fruitz]
Thank you for
using my shop.
Farewell~
scripts.translation:
[弗鲁茨]
感谢您光顾我的小店。
再见~

the number of Apples you
wish to purchase again.

A total of ^FF0000{0}^000000 Apples

Would you like to continue?

[梅尔茨]
总共^FF0000{0}^000000个苹果
需要^FF0000{1}^000000 Zeny。
您要继续购买吗？

scripts.text:

Thanks for stopping
by my shop. Farewell!
Come by anytime when
you feel like having an
Apple to snack on~

[梅尔茨]
感谢您光顾我的小店。再见！
想吃苹果点心时，
随时欢迎再来哦~

enough money with you.

purchase less Apples.

[梅尔茨]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足。
请检查您的资金，

[Meltz]
Hmm, I don't think you've
got enough room to carry
this many Apples. You might
want to free up your inventory
space.
scripts.translation:

嗯，我觉得您的背包空间
不足以携带这么多苹果。

scripts.text:

Thanks for stopping by
my shop. I hope you enjoy
the flavor of these Apples~!
scripts.translation:
[梅尔茨]
感谢您光顾我的小店。

请记住，我需要3个苹果
和1个空瓶。

给您~

by my shop. Farewell!

scripts.translation:

感谢您光顾我的小店。再见！
想吃苹果点心时，

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Longitude, 131 degrees east.
Latitude, 37 degrees north.
We're right on course, captain.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
东经131度。
北纬37度。
我们正沿着航线前进，船长。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Looks like a really
cloudy day. Always hard
to navigate when the skies
aren't clear. Guess we'll
need to amp the radar.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
看起来是个大阴天。天空不晴朗的时候，导航总是很难。看来我们需要加强雷达了。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
The Captain is a good
man and I can't think of
a finer person to command
this ship. Still, he's pretty
tough, a real slave driver.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
船长是个好人，我想不出比更适合指挥这艘船的人了。不过，他真的很严厉，简直是个压榨人的老板。

scripts.text:
[^ff0000Tarlock^000000]
^ff0000Hey...!^000000
^ff0000Less chit-chat^000000
^ff0000and more piloting!^000000

[Pilot]
R-right away, sir!
(See what I mean?)
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
是...是的，长官！
（您明白我的意思吧？）

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
This uniform is
really dapper, but
it's way too thick to
wear around the Airship.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
这身制服
真的很帅气，
但在飞空艇上穿
实在太厚了。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
...
......
No one ever really
comes into this room.
And the captain IS a reindeer.
I could just strip to my boxers.
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
...
......
从来没有人真正进过这个房间。
而且船长确实是一只驯鹿。
我甚至可以直接只穿内裤。

scripts.text:
[Pilot]
Oh...! Hello there!
E-e-enjoying your flight?!
scripts.translation:
[飞行员]
哦...！你好！
飞...飞行愉快吗？！

scripts.text:
[Dianne]
It's so weird!
I went to visit the
Airship Captain and
all I saw was this
weird reindeer. Oh!
Do you think that...
scripts.translation:
[黛安]
太奇怪了！
我去拜访飞空艇的船长，
结果只看到一只奇怪的驯鹿。哦！
你觉得那是...吗？

scripts.text:
[Mendel]
As I expected, the
in-flight meals are
three star quality at best.
*Harrrumph* I really should
have brought my chef so that
I could enjoy a real meal.
scripts.translation:
[门德尔]
果然不出我所料，
机上餐食充其量只有三星水平。
*哼* 我本该带上我的厨师，
这样我就能享受一顿真正的饭菜了。

scripts.text:
[Swordsman Shimizu]
Finally, after five
years of waiting...
I can have my revenge!
scripts.translation:
[剑士 清水]
终于，在等待了五年之后...
我可以复仇了！

scripts.text:
[Swordsman Shimizu]
I just...
Have to make sure that
I don't keep missing my
stop. But soon, very soon,
vengeance will be mine!
scripts.translation:
[剑士 清水]
我只是...
必须确保自己不要再错过站点了。但很快，很快，
复仇将属于我！

scripts.text:
[Nils]
Welcome to the
^ff0000RO Typing Challenge^000000.

a quick typing game?

欢迎来到

text as quickly as you
can without making any
mistakes! Let's start~!

嗯，这个纪录除非你复制粘贴整句话，

^0000ff{0}^000000

下次试着打破这个纪录吧~

you entered the

scripts.translation:

噢...

scripts.text:
[Nils]
The ^ff0000RO Typing Challenge^000000
is a game where you enter
the given text as quickly as you

^ff0000RO 打字挑战^000000

you know that you type
all the text that you see
in the single input line that

我想提醒你一下，

随时欢迎参加

scripts.text:
[Clarice]
Hi, I'm Clarice~
How would you like
to wager some Apples
in a friendly game of Dice?
scripts.translation:
[克拉丽丝]
嗨，我是克拉丽丝~
你想用苹果
玩一场友好的骰子游戏吗？

scripts.text: Play Dice Game
scripts.translation: 玩骰子游戏

scripts.text: Learn Dice Game Rules
scripts.translation: 了解骰子游戏规则

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm up for a game of
dice whenever you feel
like it. Just talk to me if
you ever get hit with the
sudden urge to gamble, kay?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
只要你想玩，
我随时都可以陪你玩骰子。
如果你突然想赌一把，
就来找我吧，好吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The rules for the Dice game
are pretty simple. First, you
place a bet by wagering Apples.
You can bet a maximum of 50
Apples at a time. To keep things
legal, I can only accept Apples.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
骰子游戏的规则很简单。
首先，你用苹果下注。
每次最多可以下注 50 个苹果。
为了保持合法，
我只能接受苹果。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But hey, if all that zeny
is burning a hole in your
pocket, head over to Fruitz
and you can buy as many
Apples as you want, playah~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不过，如果你口袋里的
Zeny 多得烫手，
去找弗鲁茨吧，
你可以买任意数量的苹果，
朋友~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now, we begin with me
rolling two 6-sided dice.
When it's your turn, you'll
roll two 6-sided dice. After
that, both of us will have the
option of rolling a third die.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
现在，由我先掷两个
六面骰子。
轮到你的时候，
你也掷两个六面骰子。
之后，我们都有机会
掷第三个骰子。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now here's the important
thing. If your total is higher
than 12, you'll bust, meaning
that you lose. Otherwise, the
person with the higher total
is the winner. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
现在说点重要的。
如果你的总数超过 12，
你就爆了，意味着你输了。
否则，总数较高的人获胜。
明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now, you'll be the first
to decide whether or not
you'll roll the third die. Then,
depending on your result, I'll
roll my third die... Or maybe not.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
现在，由你先决定
是否掷第三个骰子。
然后，根据你的结果，
我会掷我的第三个骰子...
或者不掷。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
When you win, you'll
receive twice as many
Apples as you wagered.
But if we happen to tie, you
get the Apples that you bet
returned to you. Fair, right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
当你获胜时，
你将获得两倍于下注数量的苹果。
但如果我们平局，
你下注的苹果会退还给你。
公平吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ooh, so you'll play with
me? Great! How many
Apples would you like to bet?
Remember, you can wager
up to 50 Apples. If you'd like
to cancel, please enter '0'.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
噢，你要和我玩？
太好了！你想下注多少苹果？
记住，最多可以下注 50 个苹果。
如果你想取消，请输入“0”。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Changed your mind?
I understand. Well then,
I hope we can play sometime.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
改变主意了？
我理解。那么，
希望我们下次能玩。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You can't bet more than
50 Apples. Remember, we
need to keep these stakes
reasonable. Please enter
a value no greater than 50.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你不能下注超过 50 个苹果。
记住，我们需要保持
赌注合理。请输入
不超过 50 的数值。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So you'll be
betting ^FF0000{1}^000000 Apples.
Is that right?
Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Mm, made a mistake?
Alright, please enter the
number of Apples you
wish to place in this bet
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，出错了？
好的，请输入您
想在这局赌注中
投入的苹果数量

scripts.text:
I'm sorry, but you
don't seem to have
enough Apples for this
bet... You can't gamble
if you can't play, you know.
scripts.translation:
很抱歉，您似乎没有
足够的苹果来下注...
没有筹码可玩，
您就无法赌博，您知道的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Good!
Now we can start
this game! I'll roll first~
^3355FF*Rolling and rumbling*^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
很好！
现在我们可以开始
这局游戏了！我先掷~
^3355FF*滚动和碰撞声*^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Rolling and rumbling*^000000
Cast Dice.
scripts.translation: 掷骰子

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Rolling and rumbling*^000000

[{0}]
Currently my total is ^0000FF{1}^000000 and ^FF0000{2}^000000, your total is ^FF0000{3}^000000. We are making an even game. Would you like to cast dice again?

[{0}]
Currently my total is ^0000FF{1}^000000 and ^FF0000{2}^000000, your total is ^FF0000{3}^000000. ^FF0000{4}^000000, you are currently winning this game. Would you like to cast dice again?

[{0}]

[{0}]
^FF0000{1}^000000, you got ^FF0000{2}^000000 and the total is now ^FF0000{3}^000000. Even though you casted dice again, still your total is smaller than mine. You lost the game. I am sorry and please try again.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^FF0000{1}^000000，你掷出了 ^FF0000{2}^000000，总和现在是 ^FF0000{3}^000000。虽然你又掷了一次，但总和仍然小于我的。你输了这局。很抱歉，请再试一次。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^FF0000{1}^000000, you got ^FF0000{2}^000000 and the total is now ^FF0000{3}^000000. I don't want to take any risk, let's end this game in a draw. Let's play again some other time~

[{0}]
Alright.
Let me cast the dice again.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的。
让我再掷一次骰子。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^FF0000{1}^000000, you got ^FF0000{2}^000000 and the total is now ^FF0000{3}^000000. Now it is my turn.

[{0}]
I see, you don't want to take risk of losing this game. Neither do I, let's end this game in a draw. Let's play again some other time~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白了，你不想冒输掉这局的风险。我也不想，让我们以平局结束这局吧。下次再玩~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It couldn't hurt to try.
Well, I win this time.
I'm sorry, let's try play
again sometime.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
试一试也无妨。
好吧，这次我赢了。
很抱歉，我们改天再玩。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see, you don't want to take risk of losing the game. Okay, let me cast dice again.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白了，你不想冒输掉这局的风险。好的，让我再掷一次骰子。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Alright.
Let me cast the dice again.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的。
让我再掷一次骰子。

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Rolling and rumbling*^000000

[{0}]
I got ^0000FF{1}^000000 and the total is now ^0000FF{2}^000000. I lost this game since my total exceeded 12. Let me give you my apples. Congratulations, that was a great game.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我掷出了^0000FF{1}^000000，总分现在是^0000FF{2}^000000。因为总分超过了12，所以我输了这局。请收下我的苹果。恭喜，这局玩得很开心。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I got ^0000FF{1}^000000 and the total is now ^0000FF{2}^000000. With total ^FF0000{3}^000000 you won this game, ^FF0000{4}^000000. Let me give you my apples. It was a great game and I hope we will play again some other time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我掷出了^0000FF{1}^000000，总分现在是^0000FF{2}^000000。你的总分是^FF0000{3}^000000，你赢了这局，^FF0000{4}^000000。请收下我的苹果。这局玩得很开心，希望下次还能再玩。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I got ^0000FF{1}^000000 and the total is now ^0000FF{2}^000000. With total ^FF0000{3}^000000 this game came out even, ^FF0000{4}^000000. Let me give you your apple back. It was a great game and I hope we will play again some other time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我掷出了^0000FF{1}^000000，总分现在是^0000FF{2}^000000。你的总分是^FF0000{3}^000000，这局是平局，^FF0000{4}^000000。请拿回你的苹果。这局玩得很开心，希望下次还能再玩。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I got ^0000FF{1}^000000 and the total is now ^0000FF{2}^000000. With total ^FF0000{3}^000000 you lost this game, ^FF0000{4}^000000. I am sorry but please try again.
